A large service can identify and eliminate these single points of failure by explicitly engineering internal redundancy (e.g., multi-region deployment, defense-in-depth). Therefore, the decentralized network's independence is merely apparent, while the large service achieves actual resilience by actively breaking correlation.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
